summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The Innovator 20+ Year Treasury Bond 9 Buffer ETF - July (TBJL) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in downside hedge alternatives. The fund aims for specific buffered losses and capped gains on the iShares 20+ Year Treasury Bond ETF (TLT) over a specific holdings period. The actively-managed fund holds options and collateral. TBJL was launched on Aug 18, 2020 and is issued by Innovator.

completeness: holdings are every published row for this account in the issuer's all-funds holdings CSV, and all of them share one Date
weights are the provider's signed Weightings values; long and short option legs, money market and Cash & Other stay exactly as published with no sum-to-100 check
shares outstanding and AUM are published only when every selected row agrees on a finite value; otherwise they are omitted rather than guessed
option legs carry a composite provider ticker, so symbol is set only for plain tickers
the CSV carries no dated history, no fund classification and no notional exposure
